name: KuantoKusta
purpose: Compare Portuguese retailer listings and prices for child car seats.
accessMethod: Public category and product pages; listing details may vary by retailer.
commercialInterests: Affiliate and retailer referral interests; not independent product evaluation.
limitations: Prices, stock, shipping and included accessories require retailer confirmation.

name: idealo UK
purpose: Compare UK car-seat offers and retailer prices.
accessMethod: Public category and model comparison pages.
commercialInterests: Retail referral and advertising interests; prices are retailer supplied.
limitations: Check stock, delivery, exact model variant and current retailer terms before purchase.

name: Árukereső
purpose: Compare Hungarian pram and pushchair listings and prices.
commercialInterests: Retail referral and advertising interests; not an independent test source.
limitations: Hungarian listings and retailer data may omit delivery or variant differences.

name: HotUKDeals
purpose: Surface community-posted UK deals tagged for baby car seats.
authority: Consumer deal community; deal accuracy and safety are not formally verified by a regulator.
accessMethod: Public deal tag and individual deal pages.
commercialInterests: Commercial deal platform; retailers and referral links may be present.
limitations: Deals can expire, be store-specific or have community-voted rankings; verify the product and seller.

name: CYBEX Cloud T i-Size
purpose: Check manufacturer specifications, compatibility, installation guidance and manuals for Cloud T i-Size.
authority: Product manufacturer; authoritative for its own product documentation, not independent testing.
accessMethod: Public product page; manuals and compatibility checker linked from page.
commercialInterests: Manufacturer product marketing and direct sales.
limitations: Claims are manufacturer statements; confirm fit for the specific vehicle and read the current manual.

name: Thule strollers
purpose: Check Thule stroller product specifications, manuals and accessories.
authority: Product manufacturer; authoritative for its own product documentation.
accessMethod: Public product catalogue and model pages.
commercialInterests: Manufacturer product marketing and direct sales.
limitations: Specifications are model and market specific; manufacturer claims are not independent evaluations.

name: Out'n'About pushchairs
purpose: Check current pushchair models, accessories, product details and support information.
authority: Manufacturer and direct retailer for its own products.
limitations: Product descriptions and customer reviews are not independent testing; verify current safety notices separately.

name: Mountain Buggy
purpose: Check Mountain Buggy model listings, specifications, accessories and support information.
authority: Product manufacturer; authoritative for its own product documentation.
accessMethod: Public product catalogue and model pages.
commercialInterests: Manufacturer product marketing and direct sales.
limitations: Regional catalogue availability differs; confirm current local availability and model compatibility.

name: UN Regulation No. 129
publisher: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UNECE)
purpose: Consult the regulatory text and revision documents for approval of enhanced child restraint systems.
accessMethod: Public regulation page with downloadable documents.
limitations: Use the latest applicable amendment and national implementation; this page's Rev.4 document is not a guarantee it is the newest text.

name: UK Product Recalls and Alerts (OPSS)
publisher: Office for Product Safety and Standards, Department for Business and Trade
purpose: Find UK product recalls, product safety reports and safety alerts, including child equipment notices.
authority: Official UK government product safety publication.
accessMethod: Public GOV.UK Atom feed for recent alerts; exact model and batch still require manual review.
limitations: Check exact model, batch and corrective action in the official notice; no feed URL recorded pending verification.

name: EU Safety Gate
purpose: Search EU alerts for dangerous non-food products and recalls.
authority: Official European Commission rapid alert system.
accessMethod: Public searchable Safety Gate portal and weekly reports/newsletter.
limitations: Search by product and brand variants; portal search is not a confirmed public data feed.

name: ADAC child seat test: Cybex Cloud T + Base T
purpose: Review the ADAC October 2023 test for the Cloud T seat, including the separate result for Cloud T with Base T.
authority: Independent motoring association product test; consult the stated configuration and test date.
accessMethod: Public model test page; summary and configuration-specific ratings shown.
commercialInterests: Nonprofit membership organization; testing and recommendations are not manufacturer claims.
limitations: Results apply to the tested model/configuration and 2023 test protocol; seat-alone and seat-plus-base results differ.

name: Which? pushchair testing methodology
purpose: Understand Which? lab safety and durability tests, parent trials, scoring and model selection for pushchairs.
authority: Independent consumer testing publisher; the methodology page is publicly readable.
accessMethod: Public methodology article; individual review scores may require membership.
commercialInterests: Member-funded consumer organization; states it buys tested products and does not accept manufacturer samples.
limitations: UK-focused methodology and standards; individual test results or reviews may be paywalled.

name: DECO PROteste: choosing a pushchair
purpose: Portuguese consumer guidance on selecting a baby pushchair for intended use.
authority: Portuguese consumer organization; guidance article, not the cited independent test dataset.
accessMethod: Public advice article; other DECO testing content may require membership.
commercialInterests: Consumer organization; subscription services may be promoted.
limitations: Advice is general and does not certify a particular product or current stock.

name: NHS: choosing a baby car seat
purpose: Provide UK public health guidance on selecting and fitting an infant car seat.
limitations: UK-specific guidance; for legal requirements and product recalls consult current official sources.

name: DGS: preventing accidents in children
purpose: Portuguese public health information on preventing accidents involving children, including road risks.
limitations: Broad accident-prevention guidance; consult current traffic law and detailed car-seat guidance separately.

name: Egészségvonal: travelling with children
purpose: Hungarian public health guidance on travelling with children, including rear-facing infant restraint advice.
limitations: General travel guidance; does not replace current legal requirements or vehicle-specific installation instructions.

name: APSI: choosing a suitable car seat
publisher: Associação para a Promoção da Segurança Infantil (APSI)
purpose: Portuguese child-safety association advice on choosing and using an age- and size-appropriate car seat.
authority: Specialist child-safety nonprofit; guidance source, not a regulator or test laboratory.
commercialInterests: Nonprofit association; none identified on the cited guidance page.
limitations: Check publication currency and current national law; advice does not establish product-specific fit.

name: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates
purpose: Convert cross-country guide prices using the ECB's published euro reference exchange rates.
accessMethod: Public HTML rates page with downloadable data formats; specific automated endpoint not recorded.
limitations: Reference rates are informational and not transaction rates; ECB may suspend individual currency rates.
